purpose: Replay every frozen interaction-factorial and exact-repeat row with eight raw-lens geometry starts.
claim_boundary: Every frozen factorial and repeat row is replayed, so raw-lensing selection is not favorable-only.
All structural and gravity settings are frozen; only declared lens nuisance geometry is reoptimized.
Eight-start outcomes supersede shallow root classifications for these rows.
Interaction effects apply only to the tested local factorial region and do not reject a parent mechanism.
